name: Send a daily Famulor call performance report to Slack

parameters.content:
## Who is this for?
Operations managers who want an aggregate view of Famulor call outcomes in a team Slack channel.

### How it works
Every morning at 08:00, the workflow reads calls created during the previous calendar day. It fetches up to ten pages, validates completeness and deduplicates call IDs. A report counts completed, failed, unanswered, busy and active calls, voice minutes, negative sentiment and analyzed success. The success percentage uses only calls with a boolean success result; unscored calls are excluded from that denominator. Slack receives one plain-text report without caller names, phone numbers, transcripts or recordings. Zero-call days still produce a useful report.

### Setup
1. Add an n8n Header Auth credential: name Authorization; value Bearer followed by your Famulor workspace API key with calls:read. Select it in Read Famulor pages.
2. Connect Slack, invite the bot to your chosen channel and enter the channel ID in Configure workflow.
3. Set the workflow timezone to your business timezone. Set Business timezone in Configure workflow to the same timezone; its default is UTC.
4. Run with Preview only enabled. Check the date window and report, then switch Preview only off and activate the schedule.

### Customization
Adjust the schedule or cohort window. This measures calls by creation time; later completions can change outcomes. It is not a billing report. A scan exceeding 2,000 records fails before Slack delivery. Configure n8n error notifications for unattended use. [Famulor API setup](https://docs.famulor.io/automations/n8n).

## 1. Read the configured window
Select your Header Auth credential. Requests stay on the Famulor API origin.

## 2. Validate and prepare
Incomplete scans stop here. No full transcripts or recordings are forwarded.

## 3. Preview, then deliver
Preview only starts enabled. Connect the destination before switching it off.
